services.desc: Looking for a fun way to keep your kids busy for the summer? Our summer camp offers 2 - 3 classes of martial arts in the morning, followed by fun, themed activities in the afternoon. Arts & crafts, fun food friday, field trips, pool and splash pad visits, museums and educational activities fill our summer with martial arts, learning and fun.
